mechanism: Gentamicin (aminoglycoside) can cause nephrotoxicity leading to reduced renal clearance of carvedilol metabolites and potential accumulation; carvedilol may mask tachycardia as a warning sign of aminoglycoside ototoxicity.
action: Monitor renal function closely, adjust carvedilol dosing if renal impairment develops, and monitor for signs of ototoxicity; consider alternative antibiotics if possible.
